notes.title: January 26th 2022 patch notes
notes.content:
-Controller joysticks now change the speed of the player based on how much the user moves the joystick. Previously, the joystick would move the player the same amount no matter how far it was pressed.
-Fixed a bug that would sometimes make the player not jump if the jump button was pressed for exactly one frame.

notes.title: Level Creator
notes.content:
The level creator for Roll The World is now released. The level creator is a powerful tool that was used to create all the existing levels in the game. In addition to this, 5 new levels will be released alongside it. These levels can be found here https://www.reddit.com/r/RollTheWorld/comments/jxma01/5_new_levels/. 

Also, every week a new level will be released that you can play. These level will be posted in https://www.reddit.com/r/RollTheWorld/.

notes.title: Roll The World Halloween Event
notes.content:
Play Roll The World between October 16th and November 2nd, and you will unlock two Halloween themed skins: The pumpkin skin and the skull skin. You will start off with the pumpkin skin, and the skull skin will be unlocked when you visit the paint shop in the abandoned lab. The main hub of the game has also been updated for a limited time during this event.

If you haven't played the game yet and are looking for a discount, the game will also go on sale during the Steam Halloween Sale between October 29th and November 2nd.
